capabilities.description: Create, modify or delete files inside the workspace; protected paths are always excluded.
Run a local process (tests, builds, scripts).
Open network connections (HTTP, SSH, package registries, git remotes).
Mutate git state: commits, branches, config, pushes or remote repository changes.
Install, update or download third-party packages.
Read credentials, private keys, tokens or secret environment variables.
Launch an additional AI agent process (sub-agent).
